topic.title: Personal Workspace
topic.shortdesc: The personal workspace is a private editing area where authors can make changes before committing them to the project.

body.p: When an author opens a project, the work is done in a personal workspace. This workspace acts as a private area where you can edit files and prepare changes before you commit them.
This helps authors work safely on multiple files without changing the shared project content immediately.

section.title: What Authors Do in the Personal Workspace

ul.li: Track local changes before committing them.
Prepare updates across several files as one set of work.

section.title: Why it Matters
section.p: The personal workspace separates in-progress work from the shared repository state. This gives authors more control over when changes become part of the project history.
